Ellie's Game Room — Real Skills Games

Six games on one page. Run a lemonade stand, make change at the register, shop on a budget, and count your profit — plus Gelli's math challenges and chess puzzles. Tap a tile to play!

Pick a game

The money games climb through levels — finish one to unlock the next and earn promotions (Helper → Stand Owner → Manager → Boss). Promotions in one game unlock the hardest levels in the others! Everything you earn is saved on this device.

Trophy Shelf — Achievement Awards

Awards light up in color the moment you earn them. The gray ones are still waiting — each one says exactly what to do.

For grown-ups: the printable packs behind these games

These games are a free taste of Real Skills Press — Lisa Fasana's screen-free printable math adventures (“Real math. Real skills. Zero screens.”). The full packs add receipts, graphing pages, flashcards, a grown-up guide, and a complete answer key.
